name: How long does it take to install a new kitchen or bathroom faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new kitchen or bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard faucet installations are completed within 1 to 3 hours. This timeframe can vary based on the accessibility of the plumbing, whether it's a new installation or a replacement, and if any unforeseen issues arise, such as corroded connections or required modifications to the sink or countertop. Our technicians work efficiently to minimize disruption, ensuring a professional and timely installation. More complex installations, such as those involving significant plumbing adjustments or specialized fixtures, may require additional time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard faucet installations typically take 1 to 3 hours, depending on accessibility and complexity. More involved projects may take longer.
